spec.main_purpose: A desk calculator with a 20-key numeric keypad and a character LCD screen, powered over USB.

payload.label: Looking for an existing open design

considered.name: TI83x (CERN-OHL-S-2.0, weak fit, KiCad board only)

payload.reason: No archetype matched; generating a new KiCad board, case and firmware. Closest open design: AriCalculator (GPL-3.0, exact fit, KiCad + shell), compared only.

decision.reason: Only part left after the filters.

card.summary: MX tactile switch, PCB mount (5 pin)

decision.reason: A 20-key numeric keypad uses mostly standard 1u keycaps, so the plain DSA 1u keycap is the best fit for a quantity of 20. The homing keycap is only for the 5 key, and the larger sizes suit modifier keys or tall keys like Enter and + on some

card.summary: LCD 4x10 character 3.3V VDD I2C or SPI http://www.lcd-module.com/fileadmin/eng/pdf/doma/dogs104e.pdf
LCD 16x2 Alphanumeric 16pin Blue/Yellow/Green Backlight, 8bit parallel, 5V VDD
LCD 16x2 Alphanumeric , 8 bit parallel bus, 5V VDD
LCD 20x4 Alphanumeric 16pin Blue/White/Green Backlight, 8bit parallel, 3.3V VDD

decision.reason: The slot calls for a character LCD, and all four candidates are one. The build is USB-powered, so a 5V part needs no level shifting or extra regulator, and a calculator needs only a 16x2 readout. C2 is 5V and has a backlight, which makes it

card.summary: LCD 16x2 Alphanumeric 16pin Blue/Yellow/Green Backlight, 8bit parallel, 5V VDD
